d:
Wait, Big Sis is white? So Erie is just really tanned?

Note on her name, the literal translation is Erindia / Erie. But Japanese doesn't have a character for "L" so "R" does double duty. So you could translate it as Elindia / Ellie. I liked the Lord of the Rings vibe to Erindia so there you go.
n: [Doujinshi] [MM] Helping a Dark Elf and Getting a Favor In Return 1.5 -- Kasshoku Elf o Tasuketara Ongaeshi Sareta Hanashi 1.5
